rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for money borrowed and repaid over time.

example.english: I still have a few years before I can repay this loan.
example.traditional: 我仲有幾年先還清呢筆貸款。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 jau5 gei2 nin4 sin1 waan4 cing1 ni1 bat1 taai3 fun2

rows.note: Use this formal term for the act or instance of lending itself, rather than the money borrowed.

example.english: The bank has decided to loan out this money.
example.traditional: 銀行已經決定貸出呢筆錢。
example.jyutping: ngan4 hong4 ji5 ging1 kyut3 ding6 taai3 ceot1 ni1 bat1 cin2
